changelog: 0.1.4: filter menu -- ALL kodirdil filters now sort to the TOP as one bulleted group (SDR was appended last), and the [COLOR] markup was dropped: select_dialog renders rows with line1.upper(), which uppercases the tag itself ([COLOR cyan] -> [COLOR CYAN]); Kodi cannot resolve that colour, so a label wrapped entirely in the tag rendered as an EMPTY row -- the blank "מיין לפי כתוביות עבריות" entry. 0.1.3: filter_results -- the kodirdil Hebrew-subs/SDR filter choices were handled AFTER the quality/provider fall-through, which built its options from a nonexistent tikiskins.<choice> property -> empty second dialog (0/0) and no filtering. The custom choices are now single-action branches handled first. 0.1.2: re-merged onto clean POV 6.07.89. Upstream renamed the source-result field URLName -> display_name (produced in modules/sources.py, consumed in windows/sources.py) and added a hidden database.merge_status setting. Textual 3-way merge was clean, but our kodirdil READS of that field (tried-source identifier in _add/_is_tried_source, and the Hebrew per-source tagline matcher) still pointed at URLName -> re-pointed to display_name so Hebrew matching keeps working. Verified: 0 URLName left, 0 upstream lines lost, valid AST, all KODIRDIL markers (3+9) + 10 hebrew_subtitles settings preserved. 0.1.1: re-merged onto clean POV 6.07.08. Upstream refactored modules/sources.py results/thread machinery (wait() -> thread_monitor()+progress_update(), removed random.shuffle, as_completed flow); our kodirdil Hebrew-subs thread + GearsAI prefetch trigger (top of get_sources) re-applied by 3-way merge, verified leak-free (0 upstream lines lost, valid AST). 0.1.0: initial Hebrew overlay re-derived fresh from the current Gears overlay (kodirdil) onto clean POV 6.07.07.
